findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so KMS key rotation defaults to disabled. The key material never rotates, indefinitely extending the amount of ciphertext produced under a single key and the exposure window if the key material is ever compromised; this also violates AWS Foundational Security Best Practice KMS.1.

deletion_window_in_days is set to 7, the minimum permitted. If the key is scheduled for deletion, whether accidentally or by a compromised principal with kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, it is permanently destroyed after only 7 days, making every object encrypted under it unrecoverable.
